label: POST-HOC mechanism analyses. Written after the formal development, delivered23 holdout and MIL control results were known. Not confirmatory; no gate here can rescue or overturn any locked decision.

item1_matched_head_only_ablation.data: development only: 91 fit sources for training, 18 selection sources (11073 windows) for evaluation; no holdout access
item1_matched_head_only_ablation.start_state: formal_coisc/seed_<seed>/results/R0/selected.pt (the paired R0 of the formal run)

identical_to_formal_COISC_except_loss_we.final_state: step 75, no early stopping, no checkpoint selection

item1_matched_head_only_ablation.lambda_rule: per sampler: min(0.10*mean(p)/mean(q), 0.20*min(p/q)) over the 8 calibration records; minimum over the two samplers; q = the regularizer term actually used by the variant

COISC_REPRO.role: harness check; must reproduce formal COISC

L0.role: primary: factual-loss-only head fine-tuning, same steps and data stream

SIGN_B.role: primary sign-only; lambda recalibrated by the same rule on q=L_sign

SIGN_A.role: supplement sign-only at the COISC lambda

PRE_B.role: supplement pre-only; lambda recalibrated by the same rule on q=L_pre

item1_matched_head_only_ablation.harness_check: COISC_REPRO head tensors bitwise equal to coisc_final.pt; if not bitwise, report max abs difference and Tp metric differences; if Tp 120 s MAE, PLE, WSR or PSM differ by more than 1e-6 relative to formal values, the ablation is reported as HARNESS_NOT_REPRODUCED and interpreted only with that caveat
endpoints: Tp MAE at 10/30/60/90/120 s (window-pooled, as in formal gates)
Tp PLE, WSR, PSM with prior lags (window-pooled, as in formal gates) and source-equal versions over 18 selection sources
PLE/WSR/PSM for all seven outputs where defined
training logs: factual loss, L_pre, L_sign per step
item1_matched_head_only_ablation.descriptive_gate_readout: the four formal development gates relative to paired R0 are computed for every variant and reported as descriptive readouts, not decisions

pre_specified_interpretation.attribution: COISC's PLE/WSR changes are attributed to the regularizer only to the extent L0 does not reproduce them; if L0 also meets the PLE and WSR 0.9xR0 readouts on at least 2/3 seeds, the manuscript must state that the sensitivity change is not specific to the regularizer
pre_specified_interpretation.accuracy_cost: Tp 120 s MAE of L0 versus R0 and versus COISC separates the cost of extra head training from the cost of the regularizer
pre_specified_interpretation.component_roles: SIGN_B and PRE_B indicate which term drives WSR and PLE changes; no component is declared necessary or sufficient from 3 seeds
pre_specified_interpretation.reporting: all variants and all seeds reported; no variant dropped; no re-running with other settings

arrays.development: formal_coisc R0 selection_predictions_and_sensitivity.npz and COISC selection_coisc_predictions_and_sensitivity.npz for 3 seeds; item1 ablation sensitivities as secondary
arrays.holdout: delivered23 window_level_sensitivity.npz; record identity [seed, source, cohort, variant] from window_level_raw_results.npz

item3_alternative_lag_reanalysis.mask_definition: t in {10..120 s}; pre = t < max(0, tau - g); post = t > tau + g; g = guard (formal g = 10)

Tp.ALL_STEPS: post = all 12 steps; pre undefined; lag-free

T6.ALL_STEPS: post = all 12 steps; pre undefined; lag-free

item3_alternative_lag_reanalysis.measured_onset_provenance: paper_eval.onset on 5 UH events (2 selection + 3 holdout), 10 s resolution; Tp onsets 10,10,20,30,20 s; T6 onsets 60,40,-,-,80 s; crude detector, small n
item3_alternative_lag_reanalysis.metrics: PLE, WSR, PSM per scenario; empty regions reported as undefined, never imputed

aggregation.development: window-pooled over 11073 selection windows (formal convention) and source-equal over 18 sources
aggregation.holdout: equal-source over the 23 delivered sources (formal convention; PSM via frozen_evaluate.SourceMedian), with the frozen 20000-draw source-cluster bootstrap (bootstrap_draws.npz counts, source_order) giving percentile CIs for COISC-0.9*R0 (PLE, WSR) and COISC-0.2*R0 (PSM)

item3_alternative_lag_reanalysis.profiles: lag-free per-step profiles (k = 1..12) of fraction S<-1e-4, median S and median |S| for all seven outputs, R0 vs COISC, development pooled and holdout equal-source
item3_alternative_lag_reanalysis.reproduction_check: PRIOR scenario must reproduce the formal development (per_seed_base_and_coisc_metrics.json) and holdout (delivered23_sensitivity_metrics.csv, all23 equal_source) Tp values to within 1e-9
item3_alternative_lag_reanalysis.interpretation: descriptive robustness of the PLE/WSR/PSM readouts to the lag prior; the manuscript frames PLE as consistency with a specified lag prior, not with measured physical delay
